questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting second to the left of B. F is sitting third to the left of D. B is sitting to the immediate right of E. A is sitting third to the left of E. A is sitting to the immediate right of G. What is the position of F with respect to E?
questions.solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre

1) F is sitting second to the left of B.

2) F is sitting third to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79256712011c0cf38e9d718b0c3ae4da90bd5ca6fc909d6b2a7b15d0a04c4112.png] 

3) B is sitting to the immediate right of E.

4) A is sitting third to the left of E.

5) A is sitting to the immediate right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02167c9276e5ebb681d866c259c3aa9c510d5283de8a84e3208c2274d2529ee7.png] 

The final sitting arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6583c4fc190481e08dd4f06682f0e7e9a2c511067986dff54984dcac2ae6468.png] 

So, F is sits Immediate left of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)".**

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and 'x' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged?

55 × 16 - 4 ÷ 7 + 3 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 55 × 16 - 4 ÷ 7 + 3 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4e3c20903908693b25a0914b64bf7dfb5fa0b12edf15383d2668c999de4c244.png] 

 
 

 Sign
 +
 -
 
 
 
 

 Interchanged
 ×
 ÷
 
 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 55 + __**16 ÷ 4**__ - __**7 × 3**__

⇒ 55 + 4 - 21

⇒ 59 - 21

⇒ 38

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3".

questions.question:
P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

P is an immediate neighbour of both T and U.

S is sitting second to the right of P.

Immediate neighbours of R are U and Q.

S is not an immediate neighbour of U.

Who is sitting to the immediate left of Q?
questions.solution:
Given:

P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

1) S is sitting second to the right of P.

2) P is an immediate neighbour of both T and U.

4) Immediate neighbours of R are U and Q.

The final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4d0457ef2ea9fdcd49e352de33058d3f8f5f6eec62af8d792b9b5a975512d68.png] 

So, 'V' is sitting to the immediate left of Q

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements: All cocktails are mocktails.

Some cocktails are juices.

Conclusion (I): Some mocktails are juices.

Conclusion (II): Some juices are not cocktails.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Draw the possible Venn diagram as per the statements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6ad87a641a76e4411f1054eb691d56fba84aca51732d63a75092b0fdf5b377c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some mocktails are juices → True (because all cocktails are mocktails and some cocktails are juices so, some cocktails are also juices)

II. Some juices are not cocktails → False (because It may be possible but not defined)

So, 'Only conclusion I follows'. 

Hence, "Option (2)" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
3 is related to 24 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 4 is related to 60. To which of the following is 6 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic follows here:

(1st number)³ - 1st number = 2nd number.

Given;

3 is related to 24

⇒ 3³ - 3 = 27 - 3 = 24

And,

4 is related to 60

⇒ 43 - 4 = 64 - 4 = 60

Similarly,

6 related is related to

⇒ 63 - 6 = 216 - 6 = 210

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**
